 Nov 18, 2026, 5:31pm EST Post Email Whatsapp Copy link Share Inna Varenytsia/File Photo/Reuters More countries are accelerating efforts to develop alternatives to Elon Musk’s Starlink service, after SpaceX and the White House traded blame for a satellite slowdown that Kyiv said undermined its defense efforts. 
 Ukraine’s president renewed his call to Washington and Musk to “be on the right side of history ” and lift speed restrictions he said were still in place. But Ukraine is forging ahead on developing independent capabilities, using a remote drone network consisting of “ flying modems ” to partially destroy the bridge linking Russia with occupied Crimea this week, the Financial Times reported. 
 Meanwhile, Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani is seeking manufacturing partners for “ an Indian-controlled alternative ” to Starlink, according to Bloomberg, amid an ongoing spat between Musk and New Delhi.
 — Brendan Ruberry AD Intelligence for the New World Economy
